title: PBPO: Prefix-Block Policy Optimization for Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.07783v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) commonly decode responses by proceeding autoregressively across blocks while iteratively denoising multiple tokens within each block. This structure makes block-level policy optimization a natural adaptation of autoregressive policy optimization. However, the exact likelihood of a completed block is intractable because it marginalizes over the intermediate states and reveal orders of the denoising process. To realize the block-level formulation, we construct a prefix-block state and use a single model evaluation to define a factorized one-step surrogate for the block likelihood. The resulting block surrogate ratio is a product of its token surrogate ratios, allowing variation at individual positions to propagate across the entire block before clipping. We therefore introduce Prefix-Block Policy Optimization (PBPO), which preserves block-level conditioning but applies surrogate importance weighting

translated_title: PBPO：面向扩散语言模型的前缀块策略优化
translated_abstract: 扩散大语言模型通常通过跨块自回归推进、同时在每个块内迭代去噪多个token的方式来解码响应。这种结构使得块级策略优化成为自回归策略优化的自然适配。然而，完整生成块的确切似然是难以求解的，因为它需要对去噪过程中的中间状态和揭示顺序进行边缘化处理。为了实现块级的优化公式，我们构建了前缀块状态，并利用单次模型评估定义了块似然的分解式单步代理。由此得到的块代理比率是其各个token代理比率的乘积，使得个别位置的变化能够在裁剪之前传播至整个块。因此，我们提出了前缀块策略优化（PBPO），该方法保留了块级条件化机制，同时应用代理重要性加权……（摘要不完整，后续内容缺失）
tldr: 提出PBPO方法，通过构建前缀块状态并利用单次模型评估定义分解式单步块似然代理，将策略优化自然扩展到扩散语言模型的块级别，使个别位置的变化能在裁剪前传播至整个块。
